llm_response.reason: The website displays classic scam traits: mimicking a global luxury brand (Balmain) without being an authorized reseller, using an unrelated domain (jasmineharris.shop) instead of an official or authorized channel, lacks visible About, Contact, Privacy, or Legal pages (no business information or contact details), employs urgent sales language, and has excessive Balmain branding. Legitimate luxury shopping sites always list full legal and business credentials. Absence of such is a strong scam indicator.
